warnings.doubled_domain: We found this record at {{.value}}. Your DNS host adds your domain for you, so enter only the first part of the name.
warnings.cloudflare_proxied: The record at {{.host}} is proxied through Cloudflare. Open it, set Proxy status to DNS only, and save.
warnings.duplicate_spf: {{.host}} has two SPF records and mail servers reject both. Replace them with this one record: {{.value}}
warnings.spf_too_many_lookups: The SPF record of {{.host}} needs more than 10 lookups, so mail servers stop reading it. Remove includes you no longer use.
warnings.spf_missing_include: The SPF record of {{.host}} does not allow your email provider yet. Change it to: {{.value}}
warnings.dmarc_missing: {{.host}} has no DMARC record. Gmail, Yahoo and Outlook expect one. Add the DMARC record below.
warnings.dmarc_multiple: {{.host}} has more than one DMARC record, so mail servers ignore all of them. Keep only one.
warnings.dmarc_reject_without_alignment: Your DMARC policy rejects mail that is not signed. Add the signing records before sending from this domain, or mail will be refused.
warnings.mx_conflict_return_path: {{.host}} already receives mail through another server. Use another name for the return path, such as {{.value}}.
warnings.cname_with_other_records: {{.host}} is an alias, so it cannot hold the text record too. Remove the alias and add the TXT record.
warnings.wrong_selector_record_type: The record at {{.host}} has the wrong type. Delete it and add it again with the type shown in the table.
warnings.ownership_token_other_workspace: The record at {{.host}} holds the code of another dimmi workspace. Replace its value with the one shown here.
warnings.propagating: One DNS server sees a record and another does not yet. This usually clears within an hour. Nothing to do.
warnings.domain_claimed: Another dimmi workspace sends from {{.host}}. To move it here, remove that workspace's verification record and keep this one.

failures.not_verified: The records were not found within three days. Check them and select Check now to try again.
failures.records_removed: The records were removed from DNS, so replies are sent from your dimmi address. Add them again to send from this domain.
failures.ownership_transferred: Another workspace proved it owns this domain, so replies are sent from your dimmi address.
failures.provider_rejected_sender: The email provider refused to send from this domain, so replies are sent from your dimmi address.

common.step_add: Add each record below with the type, name and value shown.
common.step_check: Come back and select Check now. Most hosts publish records within minutes.

cloudflare.step_open: Open your domain in Cloudflare and go to DNS, then Records.
cloudflare.quirk_proxy: Set Proxy status to DNS only for every record. A proxied alias cannot sign mail.

route53.step_open: Open the hosted zone of your domain in Amazon Route 53.
route53.quirk_quote: Enter TXT values inside double quotes, and split values longer than 255 characters into several quoted strings.

godaddy.step_open: Open My Products in GoDaddy, then DNS for your domain.
godaddy.quirk_root: Enter @ as the name of a record at the domain itself.

namecheap.step_open: Open Domain List in Namecheap, select Manage, then Advanced DNS.
namecheap.quirk_name: Enter only the first part of each name. Namecheap adds your domain.

squarespace.step_open: Open Domains in Squarespace, select your domain, then DNS settings.

vercel.step_open: Open Domains in your Vercel dashboard and select your domain.

netlify.step_open: Open Domains in Netlify, select your domain, then DNS records.

porkbun.step_open: Open Domain Management in Porkbun and select DNS for your domain.

hover.step_open: Open your domain in Hover and go to the DNS tab.

other.step_open: Sign in where you manage your domain's DNS records.
